Have you ever wondered about the significance of the geometric shapes in the centre of your birth chart? These are called ‘Aspects’. Aspects represent the angles formed between planets, which bring together the energies of the planets concerned and show how the planets relate to each other. A companion book to ‘Karmic Astrology – interpret your own birth chart’, this book increases your understanding by guiding you to interpret the meaning of the aspects in your birth chart. Written in a straight forward, easy-to-use format, by an experienced astrologer, these two books enable you to fully interpret your own chart and those of other people. Follow Meg Ann WalkerBrief content visible, double tap to read full content.Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.In her search for understanding and the meaning of life, Meg has investigated many different religions and philosophies and gained an honours Bachelor of Arts degree in these subjects. She learned Transcendental Meditation (TM), a life-changing experience that guided her to a greater interest in Eastern religious and philosophical thought. She studied Psychology and trained as a Counsellor, Hypnotherapist, Psychotherapist, NLP Practitioner and Bereavement Counsellor, worked alongside her husband in their own therapy business for many years. Then she discovered Astrology and changed careers. At her first astrology class, the tutor discussed Karmic Astrology, which is based on theories of karma and reincarnation. This brought together her interests in Eastern ideas, psychology, philosophy and spirituality and inspired her to continue studying. Now, after many years as a professional Karmic Astrologer, Meg has added "author" to her skills list, writing and sharing the knowledge she has gained over the years. When she is not interpreting birth charts or calculating one-year forecasts for clients, (www.karmicastrologyinsights.com), Meg writes eBooks, many with an astrological theme that others may use as a starting point for their own research; others from a more personal life experience perspective that others may find interesting and helpful. Her aim is always to share information in a thought-provoking manner.
